metadata.title: Clicked like a confused raccoon and somehow scored a triple kill? Valorant lost it again!
metadata.description:
Me: wildly guessing where to shoot
Enemies: probably uninstalling mid-surprise
Valorant said ‘Here’s 3 kills, don’t question it’
Tap if your aim’s a happy accident too!

Tap if your best kills come from pure chaos!
